note: Starting points found by web search on 2026-11-11. Everything here is UNVERIFIED until measured. If a better or newer option exists, add it as a new entry (never edit the history of an old one) and say why in results/findings.json.

candidates.name: LTX 2.3, 4-bit, on MLX (mlx-video)
candidates.why: Best fit for 48 GB: the 4-bit build is listed for 32 GB machines; has audio; fast family.
candidates.setup: Install mlx-video (Python, MLX) in its own virtual environment; download the 4-bit weights from Hugging Face (gajesh/ltx-2.3-mlx-q4). The full fp16 build is about 66 GB and will not fit.
candidates.licenseCheck: Read the LTX model licence on the model card before downloading (human).
candidates.tests: Smoke shots first, then all ten if it works. Record resolution, seconds of video, steps.

candidates.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (GGUF) in ComfyUI on PyTorch MPS
candidates.why: Most recommended Mac starting point in guides; text-to-video and image-to-video in one small model.
candidates.setup: ComfyUI plus the city96/ComfyUI-GGUF custom node. FP8 checkpoints FAIL on Apple Silicon (Metal has no Float8_e4m3fn): use GGUF or fp16 builds. The official ComfyUI templates default to FP8, so swap the loader.
candidates.licenseCheck: Wan 2.2 is reported Apache-2.0; confirm on the model card.
candidates.tests: Smoke shots, then all ten if it works.

candidates.name: Wan 2.2 on MLX (mlx-video)
candidates.why: Same family as the candidate above without ComfyUI: compare speed and memory between the two runtimes.
candidates.setup: Same mlx-video install as the LTX candidate; follow its README for Wan.

candidates.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 in ComfyUI
candidates.why: Listed in plan 10. Evidence for Apple Silicon is thin (one report on an M2 Ultra 64 GB with the official ComfyUI workflow at 832x480, 73 frames).
candidates.setup: ComfyUI official HunyuanVideo 1.5 workflow; expect to need GGUF or fp16 loaders instead of FP8.
candidates.licenseCheck: Read the Tencent licence on the model card (human); note any region limits.
candidates.tests: Smoke shots. Giving up after one clean failure with a recorded reason is fine.

candidates.name: LTX-2 in ComfyUI via a community MPS fork
candidates.why: Optional. LTX-2 is officially CUDA-only; a community fork reportedly works on MPS. Only worth it if the MLX route fails.
candidates.setup: See the issue and article below; torch.compile and some LoRAs are not available on MPS.

candidates.name: MiniMax H3 (community GGUF) in ComfyUI
candidates.why: Named in plan 10. Reportedly runs on a 48 GB Mac with a Q5_K_M GGUF (third-party claim).
candidates.setup: ComfyUI plus ComfyUI-GGUF; community GGUF files from about 9 GB (Q3) to 22 GB (Q8).
candidates.licenseCheck: HUMAN MUST READ THE LICENCE FIRST. Sources disagree: it may exclude local use in the US, EU, UK and South Korea, and cap commercial use. Do not download until the human has decided it is allowed for them.
candidates.tests: Smoke shots, only after the licence decision.

candidates.name: FLUX.2 klein 4B (4-bit) with mflux
candidates.why: Makes the character and place reference images the video tests need, and answers plan 10's image-model question.
candidates.setup: mflux (Python, MLX). The 4-bit 4B model is about 5 GB.
candidates.licenseCheck: Read the FLUX.2 klein licence (human); FLUX.2 [dev] is non-commercial, the 4B klein may differ.
candidates.tests: Make spikes/draft-final/inputs/maria.png, tom.png and ferry-deck.png from the briefs in shots.json (3 images, 1024 px).

candidates.name: Kokoro 82M speech on MLX
candidates.why: Small, fast, Apache-licensed speech model for narration and dialogue.
candidates.setup: kokoro-mlx or mlx-audio (Python, MLX 0.31+). One user reported silent or NaN output with the mlx-community bf16 weights on an M3 Max: check the output is audible.
candidates.tests: Say the dialogue lines in shots.json (S05) and one 30 s narration.

candidates.name: F5-TTS on MLX (voice cloning)
candidates.why: Voice cloning from a short reference, needed for consistent character voices.
candidates.licenseCheck: Check the weights licence (some F5-TTS weights are non-commercial).
candidates.tests: Clone a 10 s reference of the human's own voice (never anyone else's) and speak two lines.

candidates.name: ACE-Step 1.5 on MLX (music)
candidates.why: Full songs with vocals from a style prompt and lyrics; one listing says about 8 GB for the 8-bit turbo model.
candidates.setup: Follow the ACE-Step MLX wrapper's README; about 6 GB download.
candidates.licenseCheck: Check the ACE-Step licence on the model card.
candidates.tests: One 60 s instrumental from a style prompt and one 30 s sung verse.

candidates.name: MusicGen (AudioCraft)
candidates.why: Listed in plan 10 as the second music candidate.
candidates.setup: audiocraft or a transformers/MLX port; whichever works on MPS.
candidates.licenseCheck: Weights licence is reported non-commercial; confirm before relying on it.

candidates.name: ffmpeg Lanczos upscale (control)
candidates.why: Plan 10b path A control: what a plain resize does, so real upscalers are judged against it.

candidates.name: Real-ESRGAN 2x video upscale (MPS or Core ML)
candidates.why: Plan 10b path A: classic super-resolution. One tool reports about 0.15-0.3 s per frame at 2x on Apple Silicon (its own numbers). The 4x model is far slower.
candidates.setup: venhance (npm) or realesrgan with PyTorch MPS; frames in, frames out, then ffmpeg to re-encode.
candidates.licenseCheck: Real-ESRGAN is BSD-3-Clause; check the specific weights.

candidates.name: Video-to-video refine / structure-conditioned re-render
candidates.why: Plan 10b paths B, C and D. There is no single known-good recipe on Mac yet: finding one IS the spike.
candidates.setup: Look for a ComfyUI workflow or mlx-video feature that takes a start video (path B) or depth/edge/pose control extracted from the draft (path C) plus reference images. Record exactly what worked in INSTALL-LOG.md.
